frame_selection: All six training videos: every20frame pair1/2, retaining same-frame crowded sets, adjacent pairs, medium/long past gaps. This is a preregistered sparse crop identity pilot, not full detector-feature or online throughput measurement.
precision: AMP matches inherited detector feature producer; normalized features stored float32, local/rawImageNet tokens float16
encoders: Frozen ImageNet ResNet50, no fish fitting
